mcp.description: Read-only synthetic supervisor claim-history facts. Call get_claim_risk_facts with claim_id (lowercase clm- ID, max 100 characters) and as_of (explicit UTC timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-19T00:00:00Z). Never supply SQL or query expressions. Not an underwriting decision service.

GetClaimRiskFacts.description: Return frequency (12/24 months), USD amount totals/average/maximum, up to 20 prior claim amounts, and latest prior claim timestamp for the customer linked to a claim. Required arguments: claim_id string (lowercase clm- ID, max 100 characters), as_of UTC timestamp string (e.g. 2026-10-19T00:00:00Z). Window is (as_of minus 24 months, as_of]; current claim excluded. Last prior timestamp uses all earlier history, not only 24 months. Missing customer is an error, not zero claims. Synthetic facts for human supervisor review only.

parameters.name: claim_id
parameters.description: Current synthetic claim ID such as clm-demo-001. Lowercase ASCII letters and digits and hyphens only. At most 100 characters.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Explicit review timestamp in UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ format. Use 2026-10-19T00:00:00Z for the seeded walkthrough.
